content: Spring WebClient (reactive, non-blocking) is the recommended HTTP client for calling TMDB from a Kotlin Spring Boot backend, over deprecated RestTemplate. Use Reactor's retryWhen with exponential backoff+jitter for transient TMDB failures/429s, .timeout(Duration) per request, and avoid .block() except at coroutine bridge boundaries (or use WebClient's awaitBody() Kotlin coroutine extensions from spring-webflux + kotlinx-coroutines-reactor for idiomatic suspend-fun calls).
